The '''DC-17 hand blaster''', also known as '''DC-17 blaster pistol''',<ref name="BF1 guide" /><ref name="BF2 guide" /> was a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] wielded by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. An advanced firearm, it was fielded to elite soldiers in the army, most notably [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commanders]], and [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|clone jet troopers]].

It shared many similarities with the [[DC-15s side arm blaster]] used by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], being a more powerful variant of the standard [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]]. Capable of a much higher rate of sustained fire than its predecessors, the [[commando pistol]] was known for its efficiency and deadliness. As a result, it was a popular style for the clones that favored it to wield two at a time, as typified by [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].

==Description==
[[File:SunDjem-AoI.png|thumb|left|200px|A bisected DC-17 showing the inner workings of the blaster]]

Like all [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] of the DC-line manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], the DC-17 blaster fired blue plasma projectiles that were hyper-ionized to be especially devastating against [[Droid/Legends|droids]] while retaining its lethality against organic beings.<ref name="BF1" /><ref name="BF2" /> As a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], it could be utilized as a side-arm, and for these two reasons, it was similar in function to its more common cousin, the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbine favored as a standard secondary weapon among [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="BF1" /><ref name="BF2" />

Unlike the DC-15S, however, the DC-17 was not only more compact, but also more powerful. Alongside its superior firepower, it boasted lower recoil and a higher rate-of-fire,<ref name="BF1" /><ref name="BF2" /> and consequently, it was far more efficient than its predecessors. Because of its status as an elite firearm, it was also known as a [[commando pistol]]<ref name="BF1" /><ref name="BF2" /> and was regarded as an extremely deadly weapon.<ref name="BF1 guide" /><ref name="BF2 guide" />

The blaster carried a stun setting, as employed effectively by [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] when she was framed for the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="TCAJ">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> Besides this, it could be customized to accommodate a cable launcher, which [[Fil/Legends|Fil]] used to save his life when he fell down a trap door during a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|raid]] on [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]].<ref name="Lair of Grievous">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>

The DC-17 blaster pistol should not be confused with the [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System]], though it did share its designation with the larger weapon for a reason&mdash;they shared many of their interior components, a fact which helped explain the DC-17 blaster's unusually high stopping power and firing rate. This fact was widely appreciated by the users of the weapon, who tended to know them inside and out as part of their training. As a result, ARCs in particular tended to look down on uninformed people who puzzled over the similarity of the naming for two such apparently different weapons. High ranking ARC officers sometimes customized their DC-17s by writing on them or adding attachments such as revolving system or even a scope.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the DC-17 blasters was standard issue for [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|clone jet troopers]]<ref name="BF1 guide" /><ref name="BF2 guide" /> but was also favored among high-ranking clone troopers.<ref name="CW S1" /><ref name="tCW" />

A popular trend adopted by [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commanders]] was to wield two DC-17 blasters simultaneously<ref name="tCW" /> in a style reminiscent of their progenitor [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref><ref name="CW Campaign">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Such examples included Fil,<ref name="Lair of Grievous" /> [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], whose DC-17 were modified with [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|krayt dragon pearl]] handles,<ref name="gar">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]], [[Jet/Legends|Jet]], and [[Fox/Legends|Fox]].<ref name="Jedi who knew too much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>.

[[File:SkywalkerAndClones-TCWS6.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Clone Captain Rex, wielder of two DC-17s]]
This style was iconic for [[Rex/Legends|Clone Captain Rex]], who led [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] and [[501st Legion/Legends|the 501st Legion]] in this manner. LIke his brethren who switched off with a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] or DC-15S in some battles, Rex utilized his twin DC-17s almost exclusively throughout the entire war, occasionally using other DC-17s

The DC-17 blaster saw service with the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata]] as well. In one incident, he employed them to great effect when he, along with [[Omega Squad]], [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], Sergeant [[Kal Skirata]], former Sergeant [[Walon Vau]], Jedi Generals [[Bardan Jusik]] and [[Etain Tur-Mukan]],and later Null-class ARC Lieutenant [[Mereel Skirata]] raided a landing strip to [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|expose a terrorist operation]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>

When [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] [[Kamino uprising|rebelled]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> clone jet troopers were prominent among the ranks of the [[anti-trooper]]s fielded by the [[Kaminoan]]s, and like their counterparts in the former [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], they all equipped DC-17 commando pistols as their side-arms.<ref name="BF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The design for the DC-17 blaster seen in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' film]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]] differs markedly from its design in some media that predates it<ref name="CW S1" /> though there is no confirmation whether or not this is meant as a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]].  Though popularized by ''The Clone Wars'', this new design actually first appears in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']] where it can can be seen holstered at the hips of the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]].<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref> The original design appears to have been built from a [https://guns.fandom.com/wiki/IMI_Desert_Eagle Magnum Research Desert Eagle]. The original design in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars|Clone Wars]] resembled a stockless [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].
